notice: These are deterministic proposed transformations. They neither approve a source nor authorize execution, ingestion, release, or production use. Output checksums are intentionally null until an approved execution creates new files.

rules: Output path must be empty before execution; never overwrite an existing artifact.
The sidecar SHA-256 and every input checksum must be recorded alongside the output.
A sidecar is provenance evidence, not a source, release, or production admission.

inputBindings.meaning: canonical 30-m VLCE2 grid and complete 13-class scheme

specifications.inputVersion: NTEMS VLCE2 annual land cover, 1984–2022, 39 exact immutable archived annual versions

selection.classMeaning: Preserve every published class and nodata (255); no new forest/non-forest crosswalk is chosen by this specification.

geometryAndGrid.crs: Carry full VLCE2 NAD83 LCC WKT; projected EPSG is not asserted
geometryAndGrid.geometryPolicy: No vectorization, dissolve, repair, simplification, or per-cell geometry materialization.

output.schema: 39 single-band Byte GeoTIFFs with original nodata 255, exact grid, and one required JSON sidecar per raster

exclusions: No post-2022 coverage or current-land-cover claim.
No forest definition, loss calculation, change attribution, or provincial aggregation.
No correction of values listed in raster-defects.json without a separately approved correction specification.
qaGates: All 39 input evidence entries and their payload/sidecar versions remain exact and COMPLIANCE-retained.
Each source raster opens read-only; class domain and nodata equal the bound grid contract.
Output GDAL grid, CRS WKT, dimensions, datatype, nodata, pixel values, and SHA-256 exactly match its named input.
No output may pre-exist; sidecar validates against this spec and records tool version.
specifications.intendedUse: Checksum-bound preservation of the annual national land-cover inputs for later, separately admitted analysis.

specifications.inputVersion: CA Forest Harvest 1985–2022; raw ZIP SHA-256 c6f41dff46d91812874672edb53233dac4126952132ad6d1131ad47b11ad7aad

selection.meaning: 0 is no mapped harvest change; year values are year of greatest mapped harvest disturbance.

output.schema: one UInt16 GeoTIFF retaining 0, 1985–2022, nodata 65536; JSON sidecar

exclusions: No all-activity, permit, cutblock, or causal claim.
qaGates: Raw ZIP SHA-256, archive evidence, raster dimensions, grid, nodata, and exact 39-value VAT must match.
Output values and counts by value equal input; no resampling or changed pixels.
Output and sidecar must be newly created and checksum-bound.

inputBindings.meaning: 45th General Election/2023 representation-order source and licence evidence

specifications.inputVersion: FederalElectoralDistricts_2025_SHP.zip; 2023 Representation Order; raw ZIP SHA-256 4004a6bff0303c46bc5d9318a3c0b4a0322599bc707712a3c41acffafbef0b93

selection.identifier: FED_NUM + REPORDER; names are labels, never keys

geometryAndGrid.crs: Source PCS Lambert Conformal Conic/NAD83; retain full source CRS
geometryAndGrid.geometryPolicy: Retain all 352 source polygon features; do not dissolve multipart districts, simplify, repair, reproject, or infer geometry. Validate 343 distinct FED_NUM values and zero missing/empty/invalid geometries.

output.schema: GeoPackage layer federal_electoral_districts_2023 with four selected fields and original polygon geometry; JSON sidecar

exclusions: No boundary generalization, dissolve, clipping, transformation to census geographies, or use as an Indigenous-territory boundary.
No election result, electorate, demographic, representation, or political inference.
qaGates: Raw ZIP SHA-256, source version and archive/recovery evidence must match.
Exactly 352 features, 343 distinct FED_NUM values, REPORDER only 2023, required fields, source CRS, and zero missing/empty/invalid geometries.
Output and sidecar must be newly created and checksum-bound.
specifications.intendedUse: 2023 federal electoral district boundary context only.
prohibitedClaims: current boundary beyond the named edition

ownerDecisionReadiness.decisionRequired: Approve, reject, or defer each named transformation scope. A transformation approval still does not approve ingestion, release, or production admission.
residualBlockers: No spec has an executed output or output SHA-256.
Every source ledger row has productionAdmission false.
Ingestion, release, and production admission require separate records after successful QA.
